newsitem.title: USA: Florida puts $250 million GO issue on notice.
newsitem.headline: Florida puts $250 million GO issue on notice.

text.p: Florida will sell $250 million of State Board of Education general obligation bonds by competitive bid with 20 hours notice, the state Division of Bond Finance said Tuesday.
Under the state's 10-day notice requirement, the sale could take place Thursday at the earliest.
The issue is designated State Board of Education Public Education Capital Outlay Bonds, 1996 Series A, and will have maturities out to 30 years.
